name: super-agent
description: Single-host multi-window orchestration plugin that plans module DAGs, launches independent conversation windows with isolated worktrees, and runs independent verification.
suggestedPrompts: $super-agent Inspect this workspace, propose a modular DAG plan for my approval, and orchestrate implementation across independent windows with final verification.
$super-agent Split this feature into parallel modules with exclusive write scopes, wait for my approval, then execute and verify in isolated worktrees.
$super-agent Refactor these modules using separate independent windows in this host and produce an independently verified final patch.
